name: rock catching
desc:
If a rock or similar object is hurled at the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster}, the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} can, with a successful DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.
